study.scope: All 25 chapters and 24 techniques including nested steps, appendix, glossary, preface, introduction and foreword; relevant code and substantive figures.
study.excluded_artwork: Cover/logo artwork is nonoperational; navigation/index inventoried only.
study.evidence: Private source/member/asset-bound study; see the public assessment for its separate execution limits.

chapters.title: Changing Software
chapters.decision: Separate intended changes from preserved functionality
qualifications: Refactoring can still change resource usage.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: Working with Feedback
chapters.decision: Choose useful localized feedback and a conservative bootstrap
qualifications: Broad integration checks remain useful; historical time thresholds are not current measurements.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: Sensing and Separation
chapters.decision: Distinguish observing effects from separating dependencies
qualifications: A fake interaction does not verify real hardware or transport.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: The Seam Model
chapters.decision: Identify the seam and its actual enabling point
qualifications: Language, runtime, linker and preprocessing rules determine selection.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: Tools
chapters.decision: Use suitable existing tools for controlled feedback
qualifications: Historic tool examples are not supported current setup instructions.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Don’t Have Much Time and I Have to Change It
chapters.decision: Choose a bounded sprout, wrapper or harness under pressure
qualifications: Tested new behavior leaves an unexercised caller connection unproven.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: It Takes Forever to Make a Change
chapters.decision: Measure the actual change/feedback bottleneck
qualifications: Incremental build improvements can increase clean rebuild costs.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: How Do I Add a Feature?
chapters.decision: Separate new feature expectations from preserved behavior
qualifications: Check actual wiring, dispatch and current language semantics.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Can’t Get This Class into a Test Harness
chapters.decision: Make construction possible with the smallest useful dependency seam
qualifications: Replacement after construction cannot undo constructor effects.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Can’t Run This Method in a Test Harness
chapters.decision: Exercise the real behavior through a suitable public or extracted boundary
qualifications: Loosening private access and faking vendor APIs have separate costs.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Need to Make a Change. What Methods Should I Test?
chapters.decision: Select observations by effect propagation from the planned edits
qualifications: Account for globals, aliases, errors, repeated calls and inherited clients.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Need to Make Many Changes in One Area. Do I Have to Break Dependencies for All the Classes Involved?
chapters.decision: Use a sufficient shared test boundary for related changes
qualifications: Pinch points are edit-relative and can have bypass paths.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Need to Make a Change, but I Don’t Know What Tests to Write
chapters.decision: Characterize actual behavior with discriminating edit-sensitive inputs
qualifications: Observed defects do not become approved requirements.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: Dependencies on Libraries Are Killing Me
chapters.decision: Own a narrow boundary around an obstructive library dependency
qualifications: Avoid mirroring a whole vendor API without a concrete need.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: My Application Is All API Calls
chapters.decision: Find transformations and effect policy inside API-heavy code
qualifications: Fakes do not establish real delivery, deletion or vendor behavior.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Don’t Understand the Code Well Enough to Change It
chapters.decision: Build a source-backed working explanation of unfamiliar flow
qualifications: Scratch refactoring requires authorized write scope and isolation.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: My Application Has No Structure
chapters.decision: Explain actual responsibilities and exceptions to the first structural story
qualifications: An explanatory sketch alone does not justify a rewrite.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: My Test Code Is in the Way
chapters.decision: Keep tests understandable and their production separation explicit
qualifications: Use current project conventions rather than a historical layout mandate.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: My Project Is Not Object Oriented. How Do I Make Safe Changes?
chapters.decision: Select procedural seams from the actual build and language
qualifications: Check real/test link selection, ABI, lifetime and global state.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: This Class Is Too Big and I Don’t Want It to Get Any Bigger
chapters.decision: Extract a responsibility only when current work benefits
qualifications: Size and method counts alone do not establish the right split.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I’m Changing the Same Code All Over the Place
chapters.decision: Consolidate repeated semantic responsibility while preserving useful callers
qualifications: Byte layout, field order and exact effects can matter more than textual similarity.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: I Need to Change a Monster Method and I Can’t Write Tests for It
chapters.decision: Protect the relevant portion of a large method before bounded extractions
qualifications: A boolean sensing flag cannot establish counts, values or event order.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: How Do I Know That I’m Not Breaking Anything?
chapters.decision: Reduce bootstrap risk through focused mechanical steps and independent checking
qualifications: Compiler success does not prove values, dispatch, effects or equivalence.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: We Feel Overwhelmed. It Isn’t Going to Get Any Better
chapters.decision: Make feasible incremental progress under real team constraints
qualifications: Small protected areas do not prove system-wide safety or quantified payoff.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.

chapters.title: Dependency-Breaking Techniques
chapters.decision: Select a dependency-breaking mechanism by its assumptions and trade-offs
qualifications: Each mechanism still needs current-language and real production-path validation.
chapters.evaluation_gap: Authored cases exercise selected applications only; no chapter-wide reliability or measured performance claim.
